findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: The SDK's Blender build (node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh) reads its manifest at ./scripts/blender/targets.json from the repo root, and its pine-hollow trees, crags, cave and weapon targets build models here here; the folder moves under src/ when the SDK's build reads it there (sharddev's change).
